nodes.audit: Verified training invoice dispatch; pre-boundary lookup is SELECT-only; receipt insert/dedup lookup, finalizer and processed update are awaited. Duplicate receipts never skip recovery.
Production supplies separate refund and invoice effect adapters. Other branches stay unqualified.

Rechecks order, fetches/validates invoice and order; paid transition, enrollment/token, notification recovery; caught results propagate notificationFailed/nonfinalization or operation-local uncertainty.
Selected getInvoice/getOrder perform awaited GET and parse/validate response. No POST publication or charge is invoked by the finalizer.

Idempotent enrollment INSERT/SELECT, pending confirmation SELECT, conditional token UPDATE, notification claim UPDATE/SELECT, sent/failure UPDATE. Token creation uses local crypto. Lease expiry is not drain evidence.

Claim and sequential customer/staff send plus persisted flags; errors collected only after both paths finish, failure record awaited then throws. Null claim/false persistence now mark admitted uncertainty.
Selected customer/admin send functions await sendTransactionalEmail using existing deterministic per-order keys; no outbox or detached job.
Awaits Resend emails.send, rejects SDK error or missing acknowledgement. Provider call may be uncertain on failure; no application-level automatic retry added.
Only getConfiguredTransactionalTemplate is used: local environment/template variable construction. Other provider/marketing exports are not invoked in this chain.

Actual shared runtime target/source/producer binding, begin before task, uncertainty and settlement; no lease-based drain.
Operation-local uncertainty markers; inert outside admitted execution.
